main_text.p: המר Tumultuatus fuit, Strepuit, Perstrepuit, Fremuit: Præt. המו גוים Fremuerunt gentes, Psal.46.7. Partic. fœmin. המיה Strepera, Prov.7.11. ubi ' est loco tertia radicalis ה : Plural בראש המית In capite tumultuantium, Prov.1.21. id est, Turbarum, qua strepera & tumultuosa esse solent.
המית f. Strepitus : Constr. הֲמִית נְבָלֶיךָ Strepitus nabliorum tuorum, Jesa.14.11.

המון m. Fremitus, Strepitus, Sonitus, Tumultus: Multitudo, Turba: Copia, opum scil. Eccl.5.9. Ps.37. v.16. Et cum א loco He, האמון Multitudinem, Vulgum, Jer.52.v.15. Constr. המון גוים Multitudinis gentium, Gen.17.4. Aff. ואל־המנו Et ad multitudinem ejus, Ezech.31.2. Et cum ה loco Vau, המונה Multitudo ejus, verf.18. Plural. המנים Multitudines, Joel.3.14. Aff. וכל המונה Et omnes copias ejus, Ezech.32.20.

המיים m.p. Streperi, Thrasones, juxta quosdam: Unde defectivum, ולא מהמהם Neq, ex Thrasonibus ipsorum, Ezech.7.11. pro מהמיהם. Hebraei putant esse ex geminato Pronomine הם, quasi מהם אשר ולא Neq, ex illis qui ab ipsis sunt, id est, liberis, posteris. Sic Chaldaeus, ולא מבניהון Neque ex liberis ipsorum.

המית f. Strepitus, Sonitus, juxta quosdam; Unde cum Aff. ואל המיתו Et ad strepitum vel sonitum ejus, Prov.19. v.18. id est, Dum clamore & fletu tibi obstrepit filius, ne condonet animus tuus, ne parcito eum castigare: Vide etiam in מות in Hiphil.
המל המולה f. Tumultus, Strepitus: לקול המולה Ad vocem tumultus, Jerem.11.v.16. Sic Ezech.1.24. Est forma גדלה.
המם Profligavit, Quassavit, Contrivit: Præterit. והמתי את־כל־העם Et quassavit, Jesa.28.28.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants of the smaller Hebrew forms (notably in the entries for המון and המיים) are not fully legible at this scan resolution; they are copied as far as they can be read, without certainty. The large Hebrew headwords are set in display type and are transcribed as ordinary paragraph openings. The Latin reference "Jefa"/"Jef" has been read as Jesa, with the long s as plain s. No printed marginal notes are present on this page.
